Jeff Lignelli increased its stake in Mohawk Inds Inc (Call) (MHK) by 115.25% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Incline Global Management Llc bought 162,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.84% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jeff Lignelli held 303,500 shares of the consumer durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $70.48M, up from 141,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Incline Global Management Llc who had been investing in Mohawk Inds Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.92 billion market cap company.
